_provenance: cfr_watch.py's baseline for the 4 real CFR parts backend/app/services/compliance/regulatory_citations.py already cites. `last_known_amendment_date` starts null for every part -- this sandbox's egress proxy blocks direct access to ecfr.gov (confirmed via curl and WebFetch, both EGRESS_BLOCKED), so no date here was fabricated offline. The GitHub Actions runner that runs .github/workflows/cfr-watch.yml has real, unblocked internet access; its first live run reports each part's real current amendment_date in the job's step summary, and a human commits that real, runner-observed value back into this file as the seed. Until a part's date is seeded, cfr_watch.py treats it as 'no baseline yet' and never claims a false 'changed'/'unchanged' verdict for it.
